operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 30, 135 through 138, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only be operated in situations arising from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events (failure of electrical grid, on-site disaster, public service emergencies), for participation in an independent system operator (ISO)-declared emergency, for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), unscheduled maintenance, testing, operational training, and integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 138, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Except during integration operational period, no operation for Scheduled MCRT, stack testing, or operational training (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. Exceptions may be petitioned.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (Integration Operational Period)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 138, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During integration operational period, any operation (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for Northern Virginia for that day is less than or equal to 100. If an Air Alert is issued, operation shall be minimized.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 30, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not operate more than 32 hours per year for Scheduled MCRT.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 135 through 138)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not operate more than 35 hours per year for Scheduled MCRT.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 30, 135 through 138, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits calculated monthly as sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 138, T1, and T2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Diesel fuel oil (ULSD, renewable diesel, or blend) meeting ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 1-D S15 or 2-D S15, or having a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of 40 or maximum aromatic content of 35 volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 138, T1, and T2) for all operations
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Combined quantity of diesel fuel (in gallons) each consecutive 365-day period shall not exceed: Group 1 (Ref. Nos. 1-26) 693,402 gallons + Group 2 (Ref. No. 27) 902,242 gallons + Group 3 (Ref. Nos. 28-30) 683,314 gallons + Group 4 (Ref. Nos. 31-134, SCR and cDPF operating) 8,394,038 gallons + Group 5 (Ref. Nos. 31-134, SCR not operating and cDPF operating) 688,061 gallons + Group 6 (Ref. Nos. 135-138) 717,805 gallons + Group 7 (Ref. Nos. T1-T2) 682,223 gallons. Compliance demonstrated daily by adding total for most recently completed calendar day to preceding 364 days.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Non-emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 31 through 134)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Engine exhaust gas shall be treated with urea when the catalyst bed exhaust temperature of 572°F is achieved, except for periods of start-up, shutdown, or malfunction. The exhaust temperature at the outlet of the entire SCR+cDPF emissions control system does not exceed 1,022°F.
